messages.subject: sleeplog ID handling in ggir2.9-0 vs. 2.8-2 part 4 error and g.logload error
parts:
Hi team, 

I've had some issues in advanced sleep log handling in the new ggir update.

In the old version of ggir (2.8-2), the sleeplog file with character id vbls (e.g., "001") was linking with the GENEactiv id numbers "001" (admitedly, it only worked when sleeplogidnum=TRUE, despite the vbl being a character vbl).

However, on another computer with ggir2.9-0, the sleeplogs are not linking.
I tested the problem with g.logload and am pinning the problem down to the character formatting.

> sleeplog <-  g.loadlog(loglocation="GGIRadvdiaryT1full_TIB_00ch.csv",
+                        meta.sleep.folder= "comparisonoutput/.../meta/ms3.out",
+                        colid=1, coln1=4,
+                        nnights=14,
+                        sleeplogidnum=TRUE )
Error in g.loadlog(loglocation = "GGIRadvdiaryT1full_TIB_00ch.csv", meta.sleep.folder = "comparisonoutput/nd_A5T5_e5/output_t1_bin_files_copy/meta/ms3.out",  :
  unused argument (sleeplogidnum = TRUE)
>

This error makes sense considering a previous post identifying a change in the code (https://groups.google.com/g/rpackageggir/c/zjMjnHhXWfA/m/xlYk9m-rHgAJ)

> sleeplog <-  g.loadlog(loglocation="GGIRadvdiaryT1full_TIB_00ch.csv",
+                        meta.sleep.folder= "comparisonoutput/.../meta/ms3.out",
+                        colid=1, coln1=4,
+                        nnights=14,
+                        #sleeplogidnum=TRUE
+                        )
Error in sleeplog[cnt, 1] <- as.character(S[j, colid]) :
  replacement has length zero
In addition: Warning message:
None of the IDs in the accelerometer data could be matched with the ID numbers in the sleeplog. You may want to check that the ID format in your sleeplog is consistent with the ID column in the GGIR part2 csv-report, and that argument coldid is correctly set.
>

This error is replicated when diary is in ggir shell. The text file attached has code I have been using.

My first thought was that the character id column of the sleep log was an issue, but I can't create leading zeros in a number column, and editing all actigraph file id numbers is not an option due to the scale of the project.

The ms2 output shows there may be a space at the end of the actigraph bin file id. But this wasn't an issue in the previous version.

Another possibility I checked was that there were no empty ids in the sleep log - there was full data there. But there is one actigraph file with no id listed - i doubt this is the issue, but perhaps.

I would love to hear your thoughts, work arounds, or specification issues for this problem.

Thank you, 
Emily

messages.subject: Re: [GGIR] sleeplog ID handling in ggir2.9-0 vs. 2.8-2 part 4 error and g.logload error
parts:
Hi Emi and Wei,

I suspect that your issues are related. In 2.9-0 argument sleeplogidnum was deprecated because we thought we could automate this. Also spaces are automatically removed from ID values when we try to match sleeplog with accelerometer files. So, I am not sure where the problem originates.

Would it be possible for you to send me a test example of your problem:
  • One file from the meta/basic folder
  • Sleeplog row for that file.
You can send this via personal e-mail if you are worried about sharing data in this google group.

Thanks, Vincent

Dr. Vincent van Hees | Independent consultant | https://accelting.com/

Further, I have tried the GGIR2.9.2, it seems the ID and Date errors were fixed.

The issue was specific to the scenario of multiple study folders in your data directory. Most GGIR users do not use this and I also never use it, which should explain why this issue was not reported before. I was able to fix it with financial support by a group in Boston.
I have attached the basic file for GGIR2.9.0 for your reference.

Thanks, that file looks like a good recording. Can you share the sleep diary with me? Without that it would be difficult for me to reproduce the issue.

Thanks,

Vincent

Hi Emi and Wei,

I suspect that your issues are related. In 2.9-0 argument sleeplogidnum was deprecated because we thought we could automate this. Also spaces are automatically removed from ID values when we try to match sleeplog with accelerometer files. So, I am not sure where the problem originates.

Would it be possible for you to send me a test example of your problem:
  • One file from the meta/basic folder
  • Sleeplog row for that file.
You can send this via personal e-mail if you are worried about sharing data in this google group.

Thanks, Vincent

Dr. Vincent van Hees | Independent consultant | https://accelting.com/

On Friday, June 2nd, 2023 at 3:51 AM, Emily Westwood <emi.we...@gmail.com> wrote:

Hi team,

I've had some issues in advanced sleep log handling in the new ggir update.

In the old version of ggir (2.8-2), the sleeplog file with character id vbls (e.g., "001") was linking with the GENEactiv id numbers "001" (admitedly, it only worked when sleeplogidnum=TRUE, despite the vbl being a character vbl).

However, on another computer with ggir2.9-0, the sleeplogs are not linking.
I tested the problem with g.logload and am pinning the problem down to the character formatting.

> sleeplog <- g.loadlog(loglocation="GGIRadvdiaryT1full_TIB_00ch.csv",
+ meta.sleep.folder= "comparisonoutput/.../meta/ms3.out",
+ colid=1, coln1=4,
+ nnights=14,
+ sleeplogidnum=TRUE )
Error in g.loadlog(loglocation = "GGIRadvdiaryT1full_TIB_00ch.csv", meta.sleep.folder = "comparisonoutput/nd_A5T5_e5/output_t1_bin_files_copy/meta/ms3.out", :
unused argument (sleeplogidnum = TRUE)
>

This error makes sense considering a previous post identifying a change in the code (https://groups.google.com/g/rpackageggir/c/zjMjnHhXWfA/m/xlYk9m-rHgAJ)

> sleeplog <- g.loadlog(loglocation="GGIRadvdiaryT1full_TIB_00ch.csv",
+ meta.sleep.folder= "comparisonoutput/.../meta/ms3.out",
+ colid=1, coln1=4,
+ nnights=14,
+ #sleeplogidnum=TRUE
+ )
Error in sleeplog[cnt, 1] <- as.character(S[j, colid]) :
replacement has length zero
In addition: Warning message:
None of the IDs in the accelerometer data could be matched with the ID numbers in the sleeplog. You may want to check that the ID format in your sleeplog is consistent with the ID column in the GGIR part2 csv-report, and that argument coldid is correctly set.
>

This error is replicated when diary is in ggir shell. The text file attached has code I have been using.

My first thought was that the character id column of the sleep log was an issue, but I can't create leading zeros in a number column, and editing all actigraph file id numbers is not an option due to the scale of the project.

The ms2 output shows there may be a space at the end of the actigraph bin file id. But this wasn't an issue in the previous version.

Another possibility I checked was that there were no empty ids in the sleep log - there was full data there. But there is one actigraph file with no id listed - i doubt this is the issue, but perhaps.

I would love to hear your thoughts, work arounds, or specification issues for this problem.

Thank you,
Emily
